classes.note: Elected once, 15 December 1955, by PR in electoral districts (520 seats); dissolved by the decree of 5 July 1959.

classes.name: Pemilihan Umum Anggota DPRD Provinsi
classes.name_en: Provincial legislatures (DPRD provinsi, including Aceh's DPRA)
classes.note: Open-list PR in provincial dapil (301 in 2024 across 38 provinces), held with the DPR since 1971; the first regional councils were elected in 1957-1958. Papua's appointed seats are not elected.
classes.disposition_reason: No national canvass with candidate votes exists. KPU's open data portal holds only 2019 seats per party per provincial constituency; votes by candidate and party sit in the result decrees of the 38 provincial KPUs (about 301 constituencies in 2024), one site and format apiece, and none is gathered.

classes.name: Pemilihan Umum Anggota DPRD Kabupaten/Kota
classes.note: Open-list PR in about 2,325 dapil in 508 regencies and cities (Jakarta's administrative cities have no council), held with the DPR; each regency or city KPU declares its own result.
classes.disposition_reason: The Commission publishes only 2019 seats per party per dapil (open data portal dataset 33); candidate and party votes for the roughly 2,325 electoral districts sit in each of about 514 regency and city commissions' own decrees and sites, one format apiece, with no national file.

classes.name: Pemilihan Gubernur dan Wakil Gubernur
classes.note: Direct since June 2005 (the DPRD chose governors before), in staggered contests to 2014 and in national waves since 2015; 37 governors in 2024 (Yogyakarta's governor is the Sultan). Plurality since 2015, with an empty-box option against a single ticket; Jakarta needs over 50% else a runoff.
classes.disposition_reason: No national canvass of all tickets exists. KPU's open data portal (ds/12-17) lists only the winning ticket with its votes and the contest total for 2006-2008, 2010, 2017, and 2018; runner-up tickets and the 2015, 2020, and 2024 waves sit in each of the 38 provincial KPU decrees, which are not gathered.

classes.name: Pemilihan Kepala Desa
classes.locator: https://peraturan.bpk.go.id/Details/283617/uu-no-3-tahun-20248 (Pasal 39: eight-year term, at most two terms)
classes.note: About 75,000 desa elect a head (kelurahan heads are appointed civil servants), simultaneously within each regency on dates the regency sets (UU 6/2014 Pasal 31), for six-year terms until April 2024 and eight-year terms since. Regencies run them through ad hoc committees; results are announced by each village's committee and rarely published.

cadence.administered_by: Regency governments through village election committees

classes.name: Referendum
classes.note: No national referendum provision since the 1985 referendum law was repealed in 1999. The 1999 East Timor popular consultation was a UN ballot in a territory that left Indonesia.
classes.disposition_reason: No referendum has been held under Indonesian law; the 1999 East Timor consultation was run by the United Nations and belongs to Timor-Leste.
